## State transformer skeleton

```go
// Code generated by dimpclass (S8). State-transformer SKELETON for an S5 handoff.
// Review and complete every TODO before use. The old (V1) and new (V2) layouts
// are mirrored here because both versions of the package share one import path;
// the old process exports V1 values in its state envelope, the new process
// decodes them, calls Transform*, and installs the V2 values.

package statexform

import (
	"time"
)

// ---- example.com/c3-cache-entry-field/cache.Entry (state: reachable from package-level var Default)

// EntryV1 mirrors the old (v1) layout of Entry.
type EntryV1 struct {
	Body    []byte `json:"body"`
	Status  int    `json:"status"`
	TTLSecs int64  `json:"ttl"`
	Created time.Time
	ETag    string `json:"etag"`
}

// EntryV2 mirrors the new (v2) layout of Entry.
type EntryV2 struct {
	Body    []byte        `json:"body"`
	Status  int           `json:"status"`
	TTLSecs time.Duration `json:"ttl"`
	Created time.Time
	Hits    int64 `json:"hits"`
}

// TransformEntry maps one old Entry to the new layout.
func TransformEntry(in EntryV1) (EntryV2, error) {
	var out EntryV2
	out.Body = in.Body
	out.Status = in.Status
	out.TTLSecs = time.Duration(in.TTLSecs) // TODO(retyped): int64 -> time.Duration; check units and range
	out.Created = in.Created
	// TODO(added): out.Hits (int64) has no v1 source; the zero value is kept. Derive it from in if possible.
	// DROPPED: in.ETag (string) has no v2 destination; confirm it is safe to discard.
	return out, nil
}
```
